definitions.name: S0C.ABS
definitions.note: Absolute value of an exact number, via its square root.

definitions.name: S0C.MEDIAN
definitions.body: 'V' BIND V SORT 'S' BIND V LENGTH 'N' BIND S N 1 SUB 2 DIV FLOOR GET S N 2 DIV FLOOR GET ADD 2 DIV
definitions.note: Median of a Vector of exact numbers (mean of the two middle values when the count is even).

definitions.name: S0C.ARGFIRST
definitions.body: 'SC' BIND 'IT' BIND SC 0 GET 'F' BIND SC F [ MAX ] FOLD 'M' BIND IT SC 2 COLLECT ZIP [ 1 GET M EQ ] FILTER 0 GET 0 GET
definitions.note: Given items IT and scores SC (equal-length Vectors), answers the item with the largest score, the first such on ties.

definitions.name: S0C.SPJOIN
definitions.note: Joins a Vector of Strings into one String separated by single spaces.

definitions.name: S0C.CAPW
definitions.body: 'W' BIND W CHARS 'C' BIND C 0 GET UPPER C 1 DROP JOIN 2 COLLECT JOIN
definitions.note: Upper-cases the first character of one String and keeps the rest.

solutions.series.mad: 'V' BIND V S0C.MEDIAN 'M' BIND V [ M SUB S0C.ABS ] MAP S0C.MEDIAN
solutions.series.moving3: 'V' BIND V -2 DROP V 1 DROP -1 DROP ADD V 2 DROP ADD 3 DIV
solutions.series.runmax: 'V' BIND V 0 GET 'F' BIND V F [ MAX ] SCAN
solutions.series.mode: 'V' BIND V SORT TALLY 'R' BIND R KEYS R VALUES S0C.ARGFIRST
solutions.series.trimmed: 'V' BIND V SORT 1 DROP -1 DROP 'T' BIND T 0 [ ADD ] FOLD T LENGTH DIV
solutions.prose.longest: ' ' TOKENIZE 'W' BIND W W [ CHARS LENGTH ] MAP S0C.ARGFIRST
solutions.prose.freq_top: ' ' TOKENIZE TALLY 'R' BIND R KEYS R VALUES S0C.ARGFIRST
solutions.prose.initials_of_long: ' ' TOKENIZE [ CHARS LENGTH 3 GT ] FILTER [ CHARS 0 GET UPPER ] MAP JOIN
solutions.ledger.by_name: 'E' BIND E [ 0 GET ] MAP E [ 1 GET ] MAP GROUP 'R' BIND R KEYS R VALUES [ 0 [ ADD ] FOLD ] MAP RECORD
solutions.ledger.top_name: 'E' BIND E [ 0 GET ] MAP E [ 1 GET ] MAP GROUP 'R' BIND R KEYS R VALUES [ 0 [ ADD ] FOLD ] MAP S0C.ARGFIRST
solutions.ledger.debtors: 'E' BIND E [ 0 GET ] MAP E [ 1 GET ] MAP GROUP 'R' BIND R KEYS R VALUES [ 0 [ ADD ] FOLD ] MAP 2 COLLECT ZIP [ 1 GET 0 LT ] FILTER [ 0 GET ] MAP
solutions.ledger.largest_entry: 'E' BIND E E [ 1 GET ] MAP S0C.ARGFIRST
